## Description {#details}

<p>Sorting predicate to sort record pointers by their unique <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/callingconv/#abdf8cf606905c10634e831390981b0ed">ID</a>.</p>


<p>If you just need a deterministic order, use this, since it just compares two <span class="doxyComputerOutput">unsigned</span>; the other sorting predicates require string manipulation.</p>


<p>Definition at line 2045 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/tablegen/record-h">Record.h</a>.</p>
